name: PostOrbit
author: postorbit

sections.description:
PostOrbit is an AI-powered content generation plugin that helps WordPress site owners create high-quality, SEO-optimized articles at scale. Using advanced AI technology, PostOrbit streamlines your content workflow from ideation to publication.

Key Features

  • AI Content Ideas – Generate trending topic ideas tailored to your niche and audience
  • AI Article Writing – Transform ideas into full-length, well-researched articles
  • Campaign Management – Organize content around brand voice and target audiences
  • Content Calendar – Schedule posts and manage your publishing workflow
  • Auto-Pilot Mode – Automate content creation based on your schedule
  • AI Image Generation – Create custom featured images for your articles
  • Direct Publishing – Publish directly to WordPress with one click

How It Works

  1. Create a free account on PostOrbit
  2. Set up your campaign with brand voice and target audience
  3. Generate content ideas based on your niche
  4. Review, edit, and approve generated articles
  5. Schedule or publish directly to WordPress

External Services

This plugin relies on external services to provide its functionality. Below is a detailed description of each service used.

PostOrbit API

This plugin connects to the PostOrbit API (https://postorbit.wp-orbit.com) to provide AI-powered content generation capabilities.

What data is sent:
* Your WordPress site URL (to verify plugin installation and associate your account)
* Content generation requests including: topic keywords, brand voice settings, target audience, and campaign preferences
* Authentication tokens for secure API access

When data is sent:
* When you register or log in to your PostOrbit account
* When you generate content ideas or articles
* When you configure campaigns or settings

Service Links:
* Service: PostOrbit
* Terms of Service: https://wp-orbit.com/legal/terms/
* Privacy Policy: https://wp-orbit.com/legal/privacy/

Stripe Payment Processing

This plugin uses Stripe to process payments for purchasing credits. Stripe is only loaded when you access the payment/checkout functionality.

What data is sent:
* Payment information (processed directly by Stripe, not stored by PostOrbit)
* Your email address for payment receipts
* Transaction amounts for credit purchases

When data is sent:
* Only when you initiate a credit purchase through the plugin

Service Links:
* Service: Stripe
* Terms of Service: https://stripe.com/legal
* Privacy Policy: https://stripe.com/privacy

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • A PostOrbit account (free tier available with $5 credit)

Privacy Policy

PostOrbit respects your privacy. The plugin:

  • Sends your site URL to verify plugin installation
  • Sends content generation requests to the PostOrbit API
  • Does not collect personal visitor data from your site
  • Does not track your users’ activities

For more details, see our Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the postorbit folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to ‘PostOrbit’ in the admin menu
  4. Create an account or log in to get started

Configuration

For advanced users, you can configure the API URL in your wp-config.php:

define( 'POSTORBIT_API_URL', 'https://api.postorbit.ai' );
sections.faq:
Do I need an account to use PostOrbit?

Yes, you need a free PostOrbit account. New accounts receive $5 in free credits to get started.

How much does it cost?

PostOrbit uses a credit-based system. Each AI generation uses credits based on the complexity. New users get $5 free credits. Additional credits can be purchased as needed.

What AI model does PostOrbit use?

PostOrbit uses Google’s Gemini AI models for content generation, offering both standard and premium quality tiers.

Can I edit the generated content?

Yes! All generated content can be reviewed and edited before publishing. You have full control over what gets published to your site.

Is the generated content unique?

Yes, all content is generated fresh for each request. We recommend reviewing and adding your personal touch to ensure originality.

What languages are supported?

Currently, PostOrbit works best with English content. Support for additional languages is planned for future releases.

Can I use PostOrbit with multiple sites?

Each PostOrbit account is tied to a single WordPress domain. Contact support if you need multi-site support.
